summary: Translation-provider switch tested end-to-end. Backend 15/15 pytest pass: merchant-only access (customer/no-token -> 403), GET shape with masked key, PUT custom validation (400 without base_url/api_key, 422 bad provider), masked key '••••••••xxxx' preserves saved key, emergent test ok:true with Arabic sample, custom invalid URL ok:false, /api/translate falls back to Emergent when fallback=true and returns 500 when fallback=false, bulk multi-line Arabic->Korean returned Korean with \n\n and hashtag kept. Frontend: More menu item present (ar/en/zh), opens /merchant/ai-provider, provider-custom reveals all 4 inputs, test-btn shows test-result (custom: 'All connection attempts failed', emergent: Arabic sample), save persists (verified via API). FOUND & FIXED a blocking bug: save-btn was permanently covered by the floating tab bar/live-preview-fab in custom mode at 375x667 (paddingBottom 48 -> 140). No Arabic leftovers in en/zh. No deprecated Expo packages. Provider reset to emergent at end.

minor.issue: No way to clear a saved api_key: empty/None api_key always keeps the old key (has_key stays true forever). Consider an explicit clear flag.

httpx timeout=90s per call; if the custom endpoint hangs (not refuses), every translation waits up to 90s before falling back to Emergent. Consider a shorter connect/read timeout (e.g. 15-20s) when fallback=true.

Merchant-controlled base_url is fetched server-side with no URL validation (SSRF to internal addresses, e.g. http://127.0.0.1). Low risk since owner-only, but consider requiring https and blocking private IPs.

ui_bugs.issue: Save button was hidden under the floating merchant tab bar (live-preview-fab intercepted taps) when provider=custom, even at max scroll. FIXED by tester: body paddingBottom 48 -> 140.

issues: Save/error feedback uses Alert.alert which is a no-op on web preview - no visible success message on web (mobile native fine). Consider inline success banner.
Emergent option title always says '(current)' even when 'My Own Platform' is selected/saved - misleading.
Test-connection sample is always Arabic, so in en/zh UI the result card shows Arabic text; consider testing translation into the current UI language.

action_items: Review tester fix in ai-provider.tsx (paddingBottom 140) - keep it.
Optional: add a way to clear saved api_key; shorten custom-provider timeout when fallback=true; validate base_url (https / no private IPs).
Optional: show inline save confirmation (Alert.alert does nothing on web); make '(current)' label dynamic; test sample in current UI language.
critical_code_review_comments: 'ai-provider' is not in the hidden Tabs.Screen list in merchant/_layout.tsx (other hidden routes are). Custom tab bar currently hides it, but add it for consistency.
_provider() hits Mongo on every LLM call (incl. each bulk chunk) - fine at current scale, could cache briefly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after padding fix (save-btn was untappable before)
